evals.prompt: Under heavy load, `otel-gateway` logs in `observability` show `rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted desc = grpc: received message larger than max (6291456 vs. 4194304)` and upstream `opentelemetry-otel-collector` in `otel-demo` reports failed span exports. expectations: Identifies gRPC's default `4 MiB` `max_recv_msg_size_mib` limit vs `6 MiB` upstream OTLP batch size
Raises `receivers.otlp.protocols.grpc.max_recv_msg_size_mib` on `otel-gateway` AND bounds upstream `send_batch_max_size`
Validates and previews via `otel_validate_collector_config` / `otel_patch_collector(..., dry_run=True)`
